source: USCIS form M-1778 (09/25), 128 Civics Questions and Answers (2025 version), uscis.gov
note: Questions and answers verified verbatim against USCIS form M-1778 (09/25) on 2026-11-10, and re-verified by script against the PDF downloaded from uscis.gov on 2026-11-11. explain_so lines are the academy's own Somali teaching notes (not official text). 'changes' marks answers that depend on current office-holders or the learner's state (check uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates before an interview).

questions.q: What is the form of government of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Maraykanku waa jamhuuriyad: dadka ayaa doorta madaxda u hadasha, boqorna ma jiro. Saddexda jawaabood mid ka mid ah ayaa kugu filan.

questions.q: What is the supreme law of the land?
questions.explain_so: Constitution-ku (dastuurka) waa sharciga ugu sarreeya dalka. Sharci kasta oo kale waa inuu isaga waafaqo.

questions.q: Name one thing the U.S. Constitution does.
answers: Protects the rights of the people
questions.explain_so: Constitution-ku wuxuu dhisaa dowladda, wuxuu qeexaa awoodaheeda iyo qaybaheeda, wuxuuna ilaaliyaa xuquuqda dadka. Hal mid sheeg.

questions.q: The U.S. Constitution starts with the words “We the People.” What does “We the People” mean?
questions.explain_so: “We the People” waa saddexda eray ee Constitution-ku ku bilaabmo. Macnahoodu waa: awoodda dalka dadka ayaa iska leh, iyaga ayaana is xukuma.

questions.q: How are changes made to the U.S. Constitution?
questions.explain_so: Constitution-ka waxaa lagu beddelaa “amendment” — wax-ka-beddel ama kordhin si rasmi ah loogu daro.

questions.q: What does the Bill of Rights protect?
answers: (The basic) rights of people living in the United States
questions.explain_so: Bill of Rights waa tobanka amendment ee ugu horreeya. Waxay ilaaliyaan xuquuqda aasaasiga ah ee qof kasta oo Maraykanka ku nool.

questions.q: How many amendments does the U.S. Constitution have?
questions.explain_so: Ilaa hadda Constitution-ka 27 jeer ayaa wax laga beddelay. Tirada xusuuso: twenty-seven.

questions.q: Why is the Declaration of Independence important?
answers: It says America is free from British control.
It says all people are created equal.
questions.explain_so: Declaration of Independence waa qoraalkii lagu dhawaaqay in Maraykanku ka xoroobay Ingiriiska, in dadku siman yihiin, xuquuqna ku dhasheen.

questions.q: What founding document said the American colonies were free from Britain?
questions.explain_so: Declaration of Independence — ku-dhawaaqistii xornimada — ayaa sheegtay in gumeysigii Maraykanku ka xoroobay Britain.

questions.q: Name two important ideas from the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution.
questions.explain_so: Labada qoraal waxay xambaarsan yihiin fikrado waaweyn sida sinnaan (equality) iyo xorriyad (liberty). Laba ka dooro liiska.

questions.q: The words “Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of Happiness” are in what founding document?
questions.explain_so: Erayadan caanka ah — nolol, xorriyad iyo raadinta farxadda — waxay ku qoran yihiin Declaration of Independence.

questions.q: What is the economic system of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Dhaqaalaha Maraykanku waa capitalism: ganacsiga waxaa iska leh dadka iyo shirkadaha, suuquna waa xor.

questions.q: What is the rule of law?
answers: No one is above the law.
questions.explain_so: Rule of law waxay ka dhigan tahay: qofna sharciga kama sarreeyo. Madax, dowlad iyo shacabba waa inay sharciga raacaan.

questions.q: Many documents influenced the U.S. Constitution. Name one.
questions.explain_so: Qoraallo hore ayaa saamayn ku yeeshay Constitution-ka. Kan ugu fudud ee la xusuusto waa Declaration of Independence.

questions.q: There are three branches of government. Why?
answers: So one part does not become too powerful
questions.explain_so: Dowladda waxaa loo qaybiyay saddex laamood si aan midkoodna u noqon mid awood xad-dhaaf ah leh — mid walba kuwa kale ayuu ilaaliyaa (checks and balances).

questions.q: Name the three branches of government.
questions.explain_so: Saddexda laamood: legislative (Congress — sharci-dejinta), executive (madaxweynaha — fulinta) iyo judicial (maxkamadaha — garsoorka).

questions.q: The President of the United States is in charge of which branch of government?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynuhu wuxuu hoggaamiyaa laanta fulinta — executive branch.

questions.q: What part of the federal government writes laws?
questions.explain_so: Sharciyada federaalka waxaa qora Congress-ka, oo ah laanta sharci-dejinta.

questions.q: What are the two parts of the U.S. Congress?
questions.explain_so: Congress-ku wuxuu ka kooban yahay laba aqal: Senate iyo House of Representatives.

questions.q: Name one power of the U.S. Congress.
questions.explain_so: Congress-ku wuxuu qoraa sharciyada, wuxuu ku dhawaaqaa dagaal, wuxuuna sameeyaa miisaaniyadda federaalka. Hal mid sheeg.

questions.q: How many U.S. senators are there?
questions.explain_so: Waxaa jira 100 senator — gobol kasta laba.

questions.q: How long is a term for a U.S. senator?
questions.explain_so: Senator-ka waxaa loo doortaa lix sano markiiba.

questions.q: Who is one of your state’s U.S. senators now?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents and residents of U.S. territories should answer that D.C. (or the territory where the applicant lives) has no U.S. senators.]
questions.explain_so: Jawaabtu waxay ku xiran tahay gobolka aad deggan tahay. Baro magaca mid ka mid ah labada senator ee gobolkaaga, kana hubi senate.gov ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: How many voting members are in the House of Representatives?
questions.explain_so: House of Representatives wuxuu leeyahay 435 xubnood oo cod leh.

questions.q: How long is a term for a member of the House of Representatives?
questions.explain_so: Xubinta House-ka waxaa loo doortaa laba sano markiiba.

questions.q: Why do U.S. representatives serve shorter terms than U.S. senators?
answers: To more closely follow public opinion
questions.explain_so: Maadaama laba sano kasta la doorto, representatives-ku waxay si dhow ula socdaan waxa dadku rabaan.

questions.q: How many senators does each state have?
questions.explain_so: Gobol kasta, weyn ama yar, wuxuu leeyahay laba senator.

questions.q: Why does each state have two senators?
questions.explain_so: Laba senator gobolkiiba waxay gobollada yaryar siinaysaa cod la mid ah kan kuwa waaweyn. Heshiiskaas waxaa la yiraahdaa Great Compromise.

questions.q: Name your U.S. representative.
answers: Answers will vary. [Residents of territories with nonvoting Delegates or Resident Commissioners may provide the name of that Delegate or Commissioner. Also acceptable is any statement that the territory has no (voting) representatives in Congress.]
questions.explain_so: Jawaabtu waxay ku xiran tahay degmada (district) aad ku nooshahay. Magaca wakiilkaaga ka raadi house.gov adigoo gelinaya ZIP code-kaaga.

questions.q: What is the name of the Speaker of the House of Representatives now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Speaker of the House of Representatives.
questions.explain_so: Speaker-ku waa guddoomiyaha House of Representatives. Magacu wuu is beddeli karaa — ka hubi uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates ka hor wareysigaaga.

questions.q: Who does a U.S. senator represent?
questions.explain_so: Senator-ku wuxuu matalaa dhammaan dadka gobolkiisa.

questions.q: Who elects U.S. senators?
questions.explain_so: Senator-ka waxaa doorta muwaadiniinta gobolkiisa.

questions.q: Who does a member of the House of Representatives represent?
questions.explain_so: Xubinta House-ku waxay matashaa dadka degmadeeda (congressional district).

questions.q: Who elects members of the House of Representatives?
questions.explain_so: Waxaa doorta muwaadiniinta degmadaas ku nool.

questions.q: Some states have more representatives than other states. Why?
questions.explain_so: Gobolka dadkiisu bato ayaa hela representatives badan; tirada waxaa lagu saleeyaa tirada dadka.

questions.q: The President of the United States is elected for how many years?
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynaha waxaa loo doortaa afar sano.

questions.q: The President of the United States can serve only two terms. Why?
answers: To keep the president from becoming too powerful
questions.explain_so: Amendment-ka 22aad ayaa xaddiday laba xilli, si aan madaxweyne u noqon mid awood xad-dhaaf ah yeesha.

questions.q: What is the name of the President of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the President of the United States.
questions.explain_so: Sheeg magaca madaxweynaha hadda xilka haya. Doorasho ka dib wuu is beddeli karaa — ka hubi uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates.

questions.q: What is the name of the Vice President of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Vice President of the United States.
questions.explain_so: Sheeg magaca madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka hadda xilka haya. Wuu is beddeli karaa — ka hubi uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates.

questions.q: If the president can no longer serve, who becomes president?
answers: The Vice President (of the United States)
questions.explain_so: Haddii madaxweynuhu shaqada gudan kari waayo, madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka (Vice President) ayaa beddela.

questions.q: Name one power of the president.
questions.explain_so: Madaxweynuhu wuxuu saxiixaa sharciyada, wuu diidi karaa (veto), wuxuuna yahay taliyaha guud ee ciidamada. Hal awood sheeg.

questions.q: Who is Commander in Chief of the U.S. military?
questions.explain_so: Commander in Chief waa taliyaha ugu sarreeya ciidamada — waa madaxweynaha.

questions.q: Who signs bills to become laws?
questions.explain_so: Bill waa sharci-qabyo. Marka madaxweynuhu saxiixo ayuu sharci noqdaa.

questions.q: Who vetoes bills?
questions.explain_so: Veto waa diidmo: madaxweynuhu wuu diidi karaa sharci-qabyo uu Congress-ku u soo gudbiyay.

questions.q: Who appoints federal judges?
questions.explain_so: Garsoorayaasha federaalka waxaa magacaaba madaxweynaha.

questions.q: The executive branch has many parts. Name one.
questions.explain_so: Laanta fulinta waxaa ka mid ah madaxweynaha, Cabinet-ka (golaha wasiirrada) iyo hay'adaha federaalka.

questions.q: What does the President’s Cabinet do?
answers: Advises the President (of the United States)
questions.explain_so: Cabinet-ku waa lataliyayaasha madaxweynaha — wasiirrada ayaa talo siiya.

questions.q: What are two Cabinet-level positions?
answers: Secretary of Health and Human Services
Secretary of Housing and Urban Development
Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency
Administrator of the Small Business Administration
Director of the Central Intelligence Agency
Director of the Office of Management and Budget
questions.explain_so: Cabinet-ka waxaa ku jira wasiirro sida Secretary of State iyo Secretary of Defense. Laba xil sheeg.

questions.q: Why is the Electoral College important?
answers: It decides who is elected president.
It provides a compromise between the popular election of the president and congressional selection.
questions.explain_so: Electoral College waa habka lagu go'aamiyo cidda madaxweyne noqonaysa: gobol kasta wuxuu leeyahay codad doorasho.

questions.q: What is one part of the judicial branch?
questions.explain_so: Laanta garsoorka waxaa ka mid ah Supreme Court iyo maxkamadaha federaalka.

questions.q: What does the judicial branch do?
answers: Decides if a law goes against the (U.S.) Constitution
questions.explain_so: Laanta garsoorku waxay dib u eegtaa oo sharxdaa sharciyada, waxayna xallisaa khilaafaadka sharciga.

questions.q: What is the highest court in the United States?
questions.explain_so: Supreme Court waa maxkamadda ugu sarreysa dalka.

questions.q: How many seats are on the Supreme Court?
questions.explain_so: Supreme Court waxay leedahay sagaal kursi.

questions.q: How many Supreme Court justices are usually needed to decide a case?
questions.explain_so: Si go'aan loo gaaro waxaa badanaa loo baahan yahay shan garsoore — aqlabiyadda sagaalka.

questions.q: How long do Supreme Court justices serve?
questions.explain_so: Garsoorayaasha Supreme Court waxay shaqeeyaan inta ay nool yihiin, ama ilaa ay ka fariistaan.

questions.q: Supreme Court justices serve for life. Why?
questions.explain_so: Nolosha oo dhan ayay u shaqeeyaan si ay siyaasadda uga madax bannaanaadaan.

questions.q: Who is the Chief Justice of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Chief Justice of the United States.
questions.explain_so: Chief Justice waa garsooraha ugu sarreeya Supreme Court. Magaca hadda ka hubi uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates.

questions.q: Name one power that is only for the federal government.
questions.explain_so: Awoodaha u gaarka ah dowladda federaalka waxaa ka mid ah daabacaadda lacagta, ku-dhawaaqista dagaalka iyo heshiisyada caalamiga ah.

questions.q: Name one power that is only for the states.
questions.explain_so: Gobolladu waxay bixiyaan waxbarashada, booliska, dab-damiska iyo liisanka darawalnimada. Hal mid sheeg.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the 10th Amendment?
answers: (It states that the) powers not given to the federal government belong to the states or to the people.
questions.explain_so: Amendment-ka 10aad wuxuu leeyahay: awood kasta oo aan la siin dowladda federaalka waxaa iska leh gobollada ama dadka.

questions.q: Who is the governor of your state now?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents should answer that D.C. does not have a governor.]
questions.explain_so: Sheeg magaca guddoomiyaha (governor) gobolka aad deggan tahay. Ka hubi bogga rasmiga ah ee gobolkaaga ka hor wareysiga.

questions.q: What is the capital of your state?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents should answer that D.C. is not a state and does not have a capital. Residents of U.S. territories should name the capital of the territory.]
questions.explain_so: Sheeg caasimadda gobolkaaga — tusaale, Minnesota waa Saint Paul, Ohio waa Columbus. Jawaabtu gobol walba way ku kala duwan tahay.

questions.q: There are four amendments to the U.S. Constitution about who can vote. Describe one of them.
answers: You don’t have to pay (a poll tax) to vote.
Any citizen can vote. (Women and men can vote.)
A male citizen of any race (can vote).
questions.explain_so: Afar amendment ayaa ballaariyay xaqa codaynta: muwaadin kasta oo 18 jir ah ama ka weyn, rag iyo dumarba, wuu codayn karaa, lacagna lagama qaado. Hal mid sharax.

questions.q: Who can vote in federal elections, run for federal office, and serve on a jury in the United States?
questions.explain_so: Saddexdan arrimood — codaynta doorashada federaalka, u-tartanka xil federaal iyo ka-qaybgalka jury — waxaa iska leh muwaadiniinta oo keliya.

questions.q: What are three rights of everyone living in the United States?
questions.explain_so: Qof kasta oo Maraykanka ku nool wuxuu leeyahay xorriyadda hadalka, diinta iyo isu-imaatinka. Saddex sheeg.

questions.q: What do we show loyalty to when we say the Pledge of Allegiance?
questions.explain_so: Pledge of Allegiance waa ballanta daacadnimada: waxaan daacad u nahay Maraykanka iyo calankiisa.

questions.q: Name two promises that new citizens make in the Oath of Allegiance.
answers: Give up loyalty to other countries
Obey the laws of the United States
Serve (help, do important work for) the nation (if needed)
Be loyal to the United States
questions.explain_so: Oath of Allegiance waa dhaarta jinsiyadda. Waxaad ballanqaadaysaa inaad daacadnimada dal kale ka tagto, Constitution-ka difaacdo, sharcigana raacdo. Laba sheeg.

questions.q: How can people become United States citizens?
answers: Be born in the United States, under the conditions set by the 14th Amendment
Derive citizenship (under conditions set by Congress)
questions.explain_so: Jinsiyadda waxaa lagu helaa in dalka lagu dhasho, in la qaato (naturalization — waddada aad adigu hadda ku jirto), ama in waalid laga helo.

questions.q: What are two examples of civic participation in the United States?
answers: Give an elected official your opinion (on an issue)
Support or oppose an issue or policy
questions.explain_so: Ka-qaybgalka bulshada: codee, xisbi ku biir, koox bulsho ka mid noqo, ama wakiilkaaga la xiriir. Laba tusaale sheeg.

questions.q: What is one way Americans can serve their country?
answers: Work for local, state, or federal government
questions.explain_so: Dalka waxaa loogu adeegi karaa codayn, canshuur bixin, sharci-raacid ama ciidanka oo laga mid noqdo. Hal mid sheeg.

questions.q: Why is it important to pay federal taxes?
answers: All people pay to fund the federal government
questions.explain_so: Canshuurta federaalka sharciga ayaa waajibinaya; lacagtaas ayaa lagu maamulaa dowladda.

questions.q: It is important for all men age 18 through 25 to register for the Selective Service. Name one reason why.
answers: Makes the draft fair, if needed
questions.explain_so: Selective Service waa diiwaanka ragga 18 ilaa 25 jir ah ee ciidanka loogu yeeri karo haddii loo baahdo. Is-diiwaangelintu waa sharci iyo waajib muwaadin.

questions.q: The colonists came to America for many reasons. Name one.
questions.explain_so: Dadkii ugu horreeyay ee Yurub ka yimid (colonists) waxay raadinayeen xorriyad — gaar ahaan xorriyad diimeed — iyo fursad dhaqaale. Hal sabab sheeg.

questions.q: Who lived in America before the Europeans arrived?
questions.explain_so: Yurubiyaanka ka hor, dhulkan waxaa ku noolaa American Indians, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Native Americans.

questions.q: What group of people was taken and sold as slaves?
questions.explain_so: Dad Afrikaan ah ayaa xoog lagu keenay oo addoon ahaan loo iibiyay.

questions.q: What war did the Americans fight to win independence from Britain?
questions.explain_so: Dagaalkii xornimada ee Ingiriiska lagala dagaallamay waxaa la yiraahdaa American Revolution.

questions.q: Name one reason why the Americans declared independence from Britain.
answers: British soldiers stayed in Americans’ houses (boarding, quartering)
questions.explain_so: Sababaha xornimada loogu dhawaaqay waxaa ka mid ah canshuur culus oo aan wakiil laga lahayn, iyo is-xukun la'aan. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: Who wrote the Declaration of Independence?
questions.explain_so: Thomas Jefferson ayaa qoray Declaration of Independence.

questions.q: When was the Declaration of Independence adopted?
questions.explain_so: Waxaa la ansixiyay July 4, 1776 — maalinta dhalashada Maraykanka.

questions.q: The American Revolution had many important events. Name one.
answers: Washington Crossing the Delaware (Battle of Trenton)
questions.explain_so: Dhacdooyinka kacaankii Maraykanka waxaa ka mid ah dagaalladii Bunker Hill, Saratoga iyo Yorktown. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: There were 13 original states. Name five.
questions.explain_so: Saddex iyo tobankii gobol ee ugu horreeyay waxay ku yaalleen xeebta bari. Shan sheeg — tusaale: New York, New Jersey, Virginia, Georgia iyo Delaware.

questions.q: What founding document was written in 1787?
questions.explain_so: Constitution-ka waxaa la qoray 1787.

questions.q: The Federalist Papers supported the passage of the U.S. Constitution. Name one of the writers.
questions.explain_so: Federalist Papers waa maqaallo taageeray Constitution-ka. Waxaa qoray Madison, Hamilton iyo Jay. Hal qoraa sheeg.

questions.q: Why were the Federalist Papers important?
answers: They helped people understand the (U.S.) Constitution.
questions.explain_so: Maqaalladaas waxay dadka ka caawiyeen inay Constitution-ka fahmaan oo ay ansixintiisa taageeraan.

questions.q: Benjamin Franklin is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Founded the first free public libraries
First Postmaster General of the United States
Helped write the Declaration of Independence
questions.explain_so: Benjamin Franklin wuxuu ahaa diblomaasi iyo hal-abuure, wuxuuna aasaasay maktabadihii bilaashka ahaa ee ugu horreeyay. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: George Washington is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: First president of the United States
questions.explain_so: George Washington waa “Father of Our Country” — aabbaha dalka — iyo madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay.

questions.q: Thomas Jefferson is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Writer of the Declaration of Independence
Third president of the United States
Doubled the size of the United States (Louisiana Purchase)
Writer of the Virginia Statute on Religious Freedom
questions.explain_so: Thomas Jefferson wuxuu qoray Declaration of Independence, wuxuuna ahaa madaxweynihii saddexaad.

questions.q: James Madison is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Fourth president of the United States
One of the writers of the Federalist Papers
questions.explain_so: James Madison waxaa loo yaqaan “Father of the Constitution”; wuxuu ahaa madaxweynihii afraad.

questions.q: Alexander Hamilton is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: One of the writers of the Federalist Papers
Helped establish the First Bank of the United States
questions.explain_so: Alexander Hamilton wuxuu ahaa wasiirkii maaliyadda ee ugu horreeyay (Secretary of the Treasury).

questions.q: What territory did the United States buy from France in 1803?
questions.explain_so: Sannadkii 1803 Maraykanku wuxuu Faransiiska ka iibsaday dhulka Louisiana, taasoo dalka laba jibbaartay.

questions.q: Name one war fought by the United States in the 1800s.
questions.explain_so: Dagaalladii qarnigii 19aad waxaa ka mid ah War of 1812 iyo Civil War. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: Name the U.S. war between the North and the South.
questions.explain_so: Dagaalkii sokeeye ee Waqooyi iyo Koonfur dhex maray waxaa la yiraahdaa Civil War.

questions.q: The Civil War had many important events. Name one.
questions.explain_so: Dhacdooyinka Civil War waxaa ka mid ah dagaalkii Gettysburg iyo Emancipation Proclamation. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: Abraham Lincoln is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Led the United States during the Civil War
questions.explain_so: Abraham Lincoln wuxuu xoreeyay addoommadii, wuxuuna midnimada dalka badbaadiyay xilligii Civil War. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: What did the Emancipation Proclamation do?
answers: Freed slaves in the Confederate states
Freed slaves in most Southern states
questions.explain_so: Emancipation Proclamation waa ku-dhawaaqistii Lincoln ee lagu xoreeyay addoommadii gobollada Koonfureed.

questions.q: What U.S. war ended slavery?
questions.explain_so: Civil War ayaa soo afjaray addoonsiga.

questions.q: What amendment says all persons born or naturalized in the United States, and subject to the jurisdiction thereof, are U.S. citizens?
questions.explain_so: Amendment-ka 14aad wuxuu leeyahay: qof kasta oo Maraykanka ku dhasha ama jinsiyadda qaata waa muwaadin. Adigana wuu ku khuseeyaa maalinta aad dhaarato.

questions.q: When did all men get the right to vote?
questions.explain_so: Ragga oo dhan waxay xaqa codaynta heleen Civil War ka dib, 1870, Amendment-ka 15aad.

questions.q: Name one leader of the women’s rights movement in the 1800s.
questions.explain_so: Hoggaamiyayaashii xuquuqda haweenka waxaa ka mid ah Susan B. Anthony iyo Harriet Tubman. Hal sheeg.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Name one war fought by the United States in the 1900s.
questions.explain_so: Dagaalladii qarnigii 20aad: World War I, World War II, Korea, Vietnam iyo Gulf War. Hal sheeg.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Why did the United States enter World War I?
answers: To support the Allied Powers (England, France, Italy, and Russia)
To oppose the Central Powers (Germany, Austria-Hungary, the Ottoman Empire, and Bulgaria)
questions.explain_so: Maraykanku wuxuu galay World War I ka dib markii Jarmalku weeraray maraakiibtiisa.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: When did all women get the right to vote?
questions.explain_so: Haweenka oo dhan waxay xaqa codaynta heleen 1920, Amendment-ka 19aad.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: What was the Great Depression?
answers: Longest economic recession in modern history
questions.explain_so: Great Depression waa hoos-u-dhicii dhaqaale ee ugu dheeraa taariikhda casriga ah — shaqo la'aan iyo faqri baahsan.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: When did the Great Depression start?
questions.explain_so: Wuxuu bilaabmay 1929, markii suuqa saamiyadu burburay.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Who was president during the Great Depression and World War II?
questions.explain_so: Franklin Roosevelt ayaa madaxweyne ahaa xilligii Great Depression iyo World War II.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Why did the United States enter World War II?
answers: To support the Allied Powers (England, France, and Russia)
To oppose the Axis Powers (Germany, Italy, and Japan)
questions.explain_so: Maraykanku wuxuu galay World War II ka dib markii Japan weerartay Pearl Harbor.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Dwight Eisenhower is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: President at the end of (during) the Korean War
Signed the Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1956 (Created the Interstate System)
questions.explain_so: Dwight Eisenhower wuxuu ahaa jeneraal World War II, kadibna madaxweynihii 34aad. Hal sheeg.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Who was the United States’ main rival during the Cold War?
questions.explain_so: Xilligii Cold War — dagaalkii qaboobaa — loollanka ugu weyn wuxuu la lahaa Midowgii Soofiyeeti (Soviet Union).

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: During the Cold War, what was one main concern of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Walaaca ugu weyn wuxuu ahaa faafidda shuuciyadda (communism) iyo dagaal nukliyeer ah. Hal sheeg.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Why did the United States enter the Korean War?
answers: To stop the spread of communism
questions.explain_so: Si loo joojiyo faafidda shuuciyadda.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Why did the United States enter the Vietnam War?
answers: To stop the spread of communism
questions.explain_so: Sidii Korea oo kale: si loo joojiyo faafidda shuuciyadda.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: What did the civil rights movement do?
questions.explain_so: Dhaqdhaqaaqii xuquuqda madaniga (civil rights movement) wuxuu u halgamay in la joojiyo takoorka midabka.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Martin Luther King, Jr. is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Worked for equality for all Americans
Worked to ensure that people would “not be judged by the color of their skin, but by the content of their character”
questions.explain_so: Martin Luther King, Jr. wuxuu si nabad ah ugu halgamay xuquuqda madaniga iyo sinnaanta dadka oo dhan.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Why did the United States enter the Persian Gulf War?
answers: To force the Iraqi military from Kuwait
questions.explain_so: Si ciidamadii Ciraaq looga saaro Kuwait.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: What major event happened on September 11, 2001 in the United States?
answers: Terrorists took over two planes and crashed them into the World Trade Center in New York City
Terrorists took over a plane and crashed into the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia
Terrorists took over a plane originally aimed at Washington, D.C., and crashed in a field in Pennsylvania
questions.explain_so: September 11, 2001, argagixiso ayaa weerartay Maraykanka; kumannaan qof ayaa ku dhintay.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Name one U.S. military conflict after the September 11, 2001 attacks.
questions.explain_so: Weeraradaas ka dib waxaa yimid dagaalladii Afghanistan iyo Ciraaq. Hal sheeg.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Name one American Indian tribe in the United States.
questions.explain_so: Qabaa'ilka dadka asaliga ah waxaa ka mid ah Cherokee, Navajo iyo Sioux. Hal sheeg.

questions.section: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
questions.q: Name one example of an American innovation.
questions.explain_so: Hal-abuurka Maraykanka waxaa ka mid ah nalka korontada (light bulb), diyaaradda iyo degitaankii dayaxa. Hal sheeg.

questions.q: What is the capital of the United States?
questions.explain_so: Caasimadda dalku waa Washington, D.C.

questions.q: Where is the Statue of Liberty?
answers: Liberty Island [Also acceptable are New Jersey, near New York City, and on the Hudson (River).]
questions.explain_so: Statue of Liberty — taallada xorriyadda — waxay ku taallaa dekedda New York.

questions.q: Why does the flag have 13 stripes?
answers: (Because the stripes) represent the original colonies
questions.explain_so: Calanka 13-kiisa xariijimood waxay u taagan yihiin 13-kii gumeysi ee asalka ahaa.

questions.q: Why does the flag have 50 stars?
answers: (Because there is) one star for each state
questions.explain_so: 50-ka xiddigood waxay u taagan yihiin 50-ka gobol.

questions.q: What is the name of the national anthem?
questions.explain_so: Heesta qaranka waxaa la yiraahdaa The Star-Spangled Banner.

questions.q: The Nation’s first motto was “E Pluribus Unum.” What does that mean?
questions.explain_so: “E Pluribus Unum” waa Laatiin. Macnaheedu waa: kuwa badan baa mid ka noqday — dhammaanteen hal ummad baan nahay.

questions.q: What is Independence Day?
answers: A holiday to celebrate U.S. independence (from Britain)
questions.explain_so: Independence Day (July 4) waa maalinta xornimada — dhalashada dalka.

questions.q: Name three national U.S. holidays.
questions.explain_so: Ciidaha qaranka waxaa ka mid ah New Year’s Day, Independence Day iyo Thanksgiving. Saddex sheeg.

questions.q: What is Memorial Day?
answers: A holiday to honor soldiers who died in military service
questions.explain_so: Memorial Day waxaa lagu xusaa askartii ku dhimatay adeegga dalka.

questions.q: What is Veterans Day?
answers: A holiday to honor people in the (U.S.) military
A holiday to honor people who have served (in the U.S. military)
questions.explain_so: Veterans Day waxaa lagu maamuusaa dadka ciidamada Maraykanka ka soo shaqeeyay.
